sourceTitle: An Essay on Slavery and Abolitionism With reference to the duty of American females
description: "An Essay on Slavery and Abolitionism" by Catharine Esther Beecher is a philosophical treatise written in the early 19th century. The book addresses the controversial subjects of slavery and the abolition movement, particularly as they pertain to the role of American women in advocating for change.
